about.title: One table that mixes
about.lead: The Mischtisch was developed by DEHOGA Bayern as a statewide campaign for a living pub culture. This platform brings the idea to Saxony and adds what was missing so far: one central online booking system for every participating venue.

oneTable.title: One table per house
oneTable.text: Every participating venue — inn, restaurant or hotel — sets exactly one communal table under the shared brand and enters itself how many people fit around it.

seatsNotTables.title: Seats, not tables
seatsNotTables.text: At a Mischtisch you book a chair, not a table. Whoever comes simply joins in — alone, as a couple, or on the spur of the moment.

oneAccount.title: One account, all of Saxony
oneAccount.text: Every Mischtisch in the state runs through one central platform. Guest and venue each receive an automatic email confirmation for every booking.

join.title: Four steps into the MischTisch family

step1.title: Fill out and sign the usage agreement
step1.textBeforeEmail: Fill out the DEHOGA Bayern usage agreement with the business contact details, sign it and send it with the subject "MISCHTISCH in SACHSEN" by email to
step1.textAfterEmail: . Alternatively by post to: DEHOGA Bayern e. V., Fachbereich Gastronomie, MISCHTISCH in SACHSEN, Türkenstraße 7, 80333 Munich.

step2.title: Entry in the "Mischtisch" Finder
step2.textBeforeLink: Once the agreement is received, the business is listed in the "Mischtisch" Finder on
step2.textAfterLink: — the map where guests find all participating venues.

step3.title: Starter package from DEHOGA Saxony
step3.text: The starter package comes directly from DEHOGA Saxony — the costs have already been covered by the state association for Saxon businesses.

step4.title: The mixing can begin
step4.text: The starter package is the basis for setting up your own Mischtisch. Afterwards, the table can be activated here on the platform with seats, days and times for reservations.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know — from the usage agreement
goodToKnow.item1: "Mischtisch" is a protected word and word-figurative mark; trademark owner is DEHOGA Bayern. The brand templates from Annex 1 must not be altered or distorted.
goodToKnow.item2: The usage fee is covered by the starter package (90 € gross for association members, 120 € for non-members) — for Saxon businesses, DEHOGA Saxony covers these costs.
goodToKnow.item3: Every participating business serves every person at the Mischtisch — regardless of nationality, skin colour or gender. The innkeeper's house rights remain unaffected.
goodToKnow.item4: The agreement runs indefinitely and can be terminated by the business with a notice period of four weeks to the end of the month.

ourGoal.title: Our Goal
ourGoal.text: Mischtisch Saxony is intended to be perceivable, operable, understandable and robust for as many users as possible. Because consumers can initiate and complete reservations electronically, we take a conservative approach and treat the platform as an e-commerce service for which applicable BFSG/BFSGV requirements should be considered.

serviceDescription.title: Service Description
serviceDescription.text: The service allows users to find participating hosts, search by region/date, view host information/offers, choose reservation times, reserve multiple seats and receive confirmation. Hosts can sign in to a protected area to manage Mischtisch information.

measures.title: Accessibility Measures
measures.text: The redesign should address keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic structure, clear form labels, understandable errors, sufficient contrast, alt text, non-colour-only information, responsive/scalable layouts, logical screen-reader order, clear DE/EN content and accessible authentication/reservation flows.

currentStatus.title: Current Status
currentStatus.text: The platform is being redesigned. Accessibility should be tested and documented as part of the relaunch. Until a full assessment is complete, the site should not claim unconditional conformance with a specific WCAG level.

reportBarrier.title: Report a Barrier
reportBarrier.text: Please identify the affected page/function, the barrier and, where useful, the device or assistive technology used.

hostData.title: Host Data We Process
hostData.intro: Host registration and use of the protected host area may involve processing of:
items: special dates, closure dates and special openings
email address used for reservation notifications

purposes.title: Purposes and Legal Bases
purposes.text1: The data is processed in order to create and manage the host account, verify eligibility to participate, display the public host profile, manage Mischtisch schedules and capacity, transmit reservations, notify the host about reservations, secure the platform and prevent or investigate misuse.
purposes.text2: Where processing is required for the partner relationship, it is generally based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Necessary security, abuse-prevention and operational processing may be based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

firebaseAuth.title: Firebase Authentication
firebaseAuth.text: Host accounts are authenticated using Google Firebase Authentication. Google states that Firebase Authentication is operated through US data centres. Google provides contractual data-processing and transfer terms for relevant Firebase services.

firestore.title: Cloud Firestore and Cloud Storage for Firebase
firestore.text1: Profile, schedule, capacity, reservation-related and other platform data may be stored in Cloud Firestore. Host images are stored in Cloud Storage for Firebase.
firestore.text2: Where technically available, an EU/EEA data location should be configured and documented for Firestore and Cloud Storage.

emailNotifications.title: Email Notifications
emailNotifications.text: Reservation notifications are technically triggered through EmailJS and sent using a connected Gmail account from Google. This may involve processing the recipient address, reservation information and other message content required for the notification.
emailNotifications.recommendation: A business-managed email account, preferably Google Workspace or another contractually suitable business email service, is recommended for production use.

publicProfile.title: Public Host Profile
publicProfile.text1: Information visible to guests may include the venue name, location/region, venue type, public business information, approved images, description, Mischtisch information and public promotions or offers.
publicProfile.text2: Login credentials, authentication secrets, security information and internal administrative information are not intended to be public.

guestData.title: Guest Reservation Data
guestData.text1: Reservation data made available to a host through Mischtisch may be used only in accordance with the Terms for Hosts and applicable data-protection law.
guestData.text2: For further processing of guest data for the host's own reservation management and hospitality services, the host acts as a separate controller.

account.label: Host account/profile data:
account.text: for the duration of active participation

deactivation.label: After final deactivation:
deactivation.text: operational deletion generally within 30 days, unless legal or contractual retention requirements apply

images.label: Images/public content:
images.text: until deletion or account deactivation; limited technical backups may remain for a recovery period

logs.label: Security logs:
logs.text: generally up to 30 days, and longer where required to investigate a concrete security incident

claims.label: Legal claims:
claims.text: data specifically required to establish, exercise or defend legal claims may be retained for as long as necessary for that purpose

rights.title: Rights
rights.text1: Subject to statutory requirements, data subjects may have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection.

complaint.title: Right to Lodge a Complaint
complaint.text: Data subjects may lodge a complaint with a competent data-protection supervisory authority.

changes.title: Changes to This Notice
changes.text: This Host Privacy Notice will be updated if the platform, service providers or processing activities change.

general.title: General Principle
general.text: We process personal data only where required to operate the platform, facilitate reservations, manage host accounts, secure the service or comply with legal obligations. Mischtisch Saxony currently does not use advertising or analytics trackers.

hosting.title: Website Access and Hosting
hosting.text2: is hosted using Hostinger. When the website is accessed, technically necessary connection and server data may be processed, including IP address, access date/time, requested resource, browser/device information and technical error/security data.
hosting.text3: This processing is required for secure, stable and technically necessary website operation and is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
hosting.text4: Hostinger provides data-processing terms for covered hosting services. The specific Hostinger group company acting under the account contract and the server region used for this website depend on the configured Hostinger account/hosting contract. That configuration should be documented internally and reviewed when changed.

reservations.title: Guest Reservations
reservations.text1: Guests do not need an account. Data may include first/last name, email, phone, postal address if retained, number of seats, date/time, optional message, selected host and technical reservation/confirmation data.
reservations.text2: The data is used to transmit the reservation, check availability, document the reservation and send transactional emails. Processing is generally based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR; necessary security/abuse-prevention processing may rely on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
reservations.recommendation: remove the postal-address field unless genuinely required.

selectedHost.title: Disclosure to the Selected Host
selectedHost.text: Reservation data is disclosed to the host selected by the guest. DEHOGA Sachsen e.V. is responsible for processing needed to operate the platform and transmit the reservation. After receipt, the selected host processes the data under its own responsibility for reservation handling and its own hospitality service.

email.title: Reservation Emails
email.text1: After a successful reservation, a confirmation is sent to the guest and a notification is sent to the selected host. EmailJS is used as the technical email integration, and Gmail by Google is the email service connected to EmailJS.
email.text2: The email flow may process the guest's name and email address, the selected host, reservation date/time, number of seats and other reservation information required for the confirmation message.
email.text3: EmailJS publishes a data-processing agreement. Gmail is a Google service; under Google's privacy information, Google Ireland Limited is generally responsible for Google services provided to users in the European Economic Area. Google processes email content and related technical information in order to provide and secure Gmail.
email.text4: The legal basis for transactional reservation messages is generally Article 6(1)(b) GDPR; necessary delivery/security processing may rely on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
email.recommendation: the Gmail mailbox used for production reservation emails should be managed as a business account (preferably Google Workspace or another contractually suitable business email service).

firebase.title: Google Firebase
firebase.text: Firebase Authentication is used only for host accounts. Google states that Firebase Authentication is operated through US data centres. Cloud Firestore stores platform/host/reservation data, and Cloud Storage for Firebase stores host images. Google provides Firebase data-processing/security terms and SCCs for relevant international transfers.
firebase.recommendation: use/document an EU/EEA location for Firestore and Cloud Storage where available.

storage.title: Technically Necessary Storage
storage.text: Technically necessary browser storage/tokens may be used for host login/session handling, language preference, security and necessary form/session state. No analytics, advertising or marketing trackers are currently planned.

automated.title: No Automated Decision-Making
automated.text: Mischtisch Saxony currently does not use solely automated decision-making or profiling within Article 22 GDPR. A final seat-availability check is not guest profiling.

operational.label: Operational reservation data:
operational.text: up to 90 days after reservation date

items.deletion: Then deletion/anonymisation unless a specific legal need exists

host.label: Host account/profile:
host.text: while active; operational deletion generally within 30 days after final deactivation

images.label: Host images:
images.text: until deletion/deactivation, subject to limited backup periods

email.label: Email delivery information:
email.text: only as long as necessary for delivery/troubleshooting

items.dispute: Data required for a concrete dispute may be retained separately with restricted access for as long as necessary. The regular German civil-law limitation period is generally three years.
